verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's own materials say teams can design, run, and analyze tests and rollouts alongside their analytics. The Feature Flags API assigns users to variants for experiments, so a first-party A/B experiment capability exists. However, nothing in the pack documents defining goal metrics or reporting statistical significance on results. Missing for 10: documented goal or primary-metric configuration, statistical significance or confidence reporting on experiment results, in-depth experiment-report docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
